route_empty_hint: Toggle planning mode (target button) and tap the map to add waypoints — or long-press the map.
route_next_hint: Route calculation arrives with the routing engine in milestone M1 (E3). Drag markers to move, tap a marker to delete.
difficulty_empty_hint: Difficulty preferences arrive with the routing engine in milestone M1.
routes_empty_hint: Nothing saved yet — plan a route and save it to find it here.
geolocation_unavailable: Location is unavailable on this device
attribution_elevation: Elevation data: Mapzen / AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain)
plan_hint: Tap the map to add waypoints
loading_fallback: Overpass unreachable — loading via OSM API…
error_no_route: No route found for these waypoints
error_waypoint: A waypoint is too far from any road or trail
corridor_error_hint: All data servers are unreachable. Check your connection, VPN or ad blocker, then retry.
tiles_url_hint: Base URL of your tile build (contains manifest.json). Leave empty to use public Overpass servers.
unsnapped_note: Not on a road or trail
diff_mtb_hint: MTB scale: 0 = gravel road · 4–5 = push/carry (uphill scale)
diff_sac_hint: SAC scale: T1 = hiking trail · T6 = alpine, difficult
diff_bands_hint: Upper limit = hard exclusion. Lower limit = preference (never excludes).
diff_legend: Difficulty comes from OSM tags where available; untagged ways get a conservative inference.
routes_save_hint: Plan a route first (two waypoints), then save it here.
